messages:
Maya: Planning to run the user_metadata.schema migration during Wed 03:30-04:30 UTC quiesce window. Heads up — backfill touches ~120M rows. Need coordination on quiesce, locks, and rollback plan.

Sam: Ack. Can you paste the migration and estimated lock time? We'll schedule SRE and canary.

Maya: Migration is lightweight DDL + iterative backfill: `ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN metadata JSONB;` backfill script runs in 100k-row batches with WHERE metadata IS NULL. Expect ~6-9 min per shard under normal load, but worst-case 2.5 hours without quiesce. We'll quiesce writes to /api/users endpoints.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: preflight checks started for migration job user_metadata.v2... preflight OK — replicas healthy, binlog lag 0-2s, PG connections below threshold.

Oliver: SRE oncall here. We'll enable quiesce at 03:25 and monitor pg_locks + replication. Add a kill-switch if backfill >30m/iteration. Also want a read-only fallback for the user write path if needed.

Kevin: Can product freeze on schema change toggles? We should pin the client SDK to v2.1 for two releases to avoid surprises.

Maya: Yes. We'll add feature flag `user.metadata_opt_in` and set rollout=off during migration. Plan: 1) enable quiesce 03:25, 2) run ALTER, 3) start backfill in parallel workers (3 shards), 4) monitor, 5) unquiesce at 04:20 or earlier if done.

Sam: Add rollout notes for release: 'DB: add users.metadata (nullable) and background backfill. Apps must tolerate null metadata and respect user.metadata_opt_in flag.' I'll draft release notes after run.

Oliver: Monitoring checklist: pg_locks, pg_stat_activity, replication lag, CPU, I/O. Create incident channel #incidents if any page-worthy alarms.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: migration job started at 1918765600, step=ALTER, ETA ~30s. Logs: ALTER TABLE queued -> exclusive lock acquired for 12ms. Proceeding to backfill.

Maya: Backfill launched with worker command: ```python backfill.py --batch 100000 --parallel 3 --sleep 0.2``` Using resume tokens and idempotent updates. We'll rotate cache TTLs to avoid stampede.

Oliver: Seeing a slight spike in xact_time ~1.2s per batch but replication lag steady at 1-3s. No long-held locks blocking reads.

Sam: If backfill stalls >15m on any shard, what's rollback? Maya?

Maya: Rollback plan: stop workers, remove any temporary indexes, keep the new column (nullable) but flip feature flag off so apps ignore metadata. We won't DROP column in rollback window to avoid data loss. Resume backfill in next agreed window.

Kevin: :thumbsup: I'll prepare a short customer-facing blurb on the status page in case of >2m read latency.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: backfill complete for shards 1-3 at 1918765920. Validation queries passed (row counts match). All health checks green. Quiesce lift scheduled at 1918765925.

Maya: Unquiescing now. Feature flag remains off for one release; we'll enable opt-in gradually after 24h monitoring.

Oliver: Closing loop: if anything unexpected, create a short postmortem. Otherwise mark migration successful and tag commit release/migrations/2026-03-user-metadata for traceability.
